notes: CLEANER, SMOOTHER. The top bar now slides out of the way while you scroll down and comes back the moment you scroll up, and Exercises and Settings drop the key/tempo bar they never used. Exercises is calmer: one clear Start/Continue, topics open into collapsible units, and questions change in place with a soft fade instead of redrawing the page; the answer footer swaps Show answer for Next without anything jumping, ear questions get one big play button, and opening Exercises silences the metronome and jam. On Keys, chord and arpeggio options only appear when they apply (+Bass/Strum with Triads or 7ths; rate, direction, range and Hold once Arp is on). NOTE: this update is live on web/desktop/PWA immediately; the Android APK build lags until the next PC build.
